evals.input: Write the April report for ACME Co. Organic traffic up 18%, CVR went from 1.4% to 2.2%, published 3 of 4 planned blog posts, paid CPL missed target ($52 vs $40 target).
expect: Executive summary leads with the most important result and is 3–5 sentences
Goals vs Results table shows all four metrics with hit/partial/missed status
Missed CPL goal is acknowledged with an explanation and what changes next month
Work Completed section lists the blog posts with the partial delivery noted
Next Period Plan includes specific targets, not vague plans
Tone is direct — does not bury the CPL miss

evals.input: It was a bad month — nothing performed. How do I write this report?
expect: Advises stating the results plainly in the executive summary without hiding them
Suggests explaining root causes specifically, not generically
Recommends leading the next-period plan with concrete changes that address what failed
Notes that clients respect honesty more than spin
